Engineering Orchestrator.tag: Keeps engineering projects moving and flags blocked work before deadlines slip.
Engineering Orchestrator.ask: Plan the bracket redesign for the Line 3 conveyor. Four engineers, ship in 3 weeks.
steps: Split the job into 14 tasks across CAD, FEA, drawings and supplier quote.
Assigned owners by skill and load. Critical path: FEA, then drawings, then supplier.
Load check on the new bracket: max stress 61% of yield at 2x rated load.
Supplier quote has no owner and blocks day 12. Flagged to the lead.

AI Swarm Problem Solver.tag: A team of AI agents takes a business problem apart and ranks fixes.
AI Swarm Problem Solver.ask: Our warehouse ships 9% of orders late. Why, and what should we fix first?
steps: Read 4,812 sample orders. Late orders cluster on Mondays and on multi-item picks.
Tested 5 explanations. Weekend backlog and pick-path length explain 78% of delays.
Rejected 'carrier delays': on-time rate is the same across carriers.
Ranked fixes by impact and effort.

Digital vCard.tag: A phone-first business card your team shares by link or QR.
Digital vCard.ask: Make cards for our three-person sales team with our logo and colors.
steps: Pulled brand colors and logo. Built one card layout for the team.
Created 3 cards with one-tap call, email, text and save-to-contacts.
Generated a QR code and short link for each person.
Turned on view and save counts for each card.

Robot Agent Layer.tag: Plans robot tasks and knows when to hand off to a person.
Robot Agent Layer.ask: Hotel floor 4: deliver towels to 412 and 418, then check the ice machine.
steps: Built a route: linen room, 412, 418, ice machine. 6 minutes.
Hallway cleaning cart detected near 415. Rerouted around it.
Delivered to 412 and 418. Guests confirmed on the door screen.
Ice machine shows a fault code the robot can't clear. Paged maintenance.

TerraFleet Autonomous Garden Robotics.tag: Coordinates robots that tend gardens and growing beds.
TerraFleet Autonomous Garden Robotics.ask: Tend beds 1 to 6 today. Rain is forecast tomorrow.
steps: Soil moisture low in beds 2 and 5. Beds 1, 3, 4, 6 fine.
Skip full watering because of rain. Light top-up for beds 2 and 5 only.
Cleared weeds in beds 3 and 4. 212 weeds removed.
Aphids spotted on bed 6 kale. Photo sent for review.

Autarkic Field Engineering & Telemetry S.tag: Design and monitor off-grid water, power and storage systems.
Autarkic Field Engineering & Telemetry S.ask: Size a solar and battery system for a 4-person off-grid cabin.
steps: Estimated 9.2 kWh a day, peak 3.1 kW, from typical appliances.
Chose 5.4 kW of panels and 20 kWh of battery for 2 cloudy days.
Added a ram pump from the creek: 1,100 litres a day, no electricity.
Set phone alerts for battery under 30% and pump stalls.

OmniNet AI: Network Diagnostics & Self-H.tag: Finds network faults, predicts failures and fixes common problems.
OmniNet AI: Network Diagnostics & Self-H.ask: Staff say Wi-Fi drops every afternoon in the back office.
steps: Found 38 devices. Access point AP-3 restarts around 2 pm daily.
AP-3 shares channel 6 with two neighbor networks. Interference peaks at 2 pm.
Switch port 14 shows rising errors. Likely to fail within 30 days.
Moved AP-3 to channel 11 and scheduled a check tomorrow at 2 pm.

Stratum MCP: Cloud Resource Control Plan.tag: Control cloud resources from one AI-ready control plane.
Stratum MCP: Cloud Resource Control Plan.ask: Why did our cloud bill jump this month?
steps: Read 3 accounts: 126 resources across compute, storage and databases.
Bill up 31%. Most of it is 4 test servers left running since the 3rd.
Those servers have no owner tag, which breaks your tagging rule.
Prepared a shutdown plan. Waiting for your approval before anything changes.

AI Governance & Guardrails Platform.tag: Track AI use, vet AI vendors and stay inside your rules.
AI Governance & Guardrails Platform.ask: Which AI tools are our teams using, and are any a risk?
steps: Found 11 AI tools in use across 6 teams.
Scored each vendor on data retention, training on your data, and access controls.
2 tools allow training on your data, which your policy forbids.
Drafted a one-page summary for leadership with fixes.

AgentForge: GenAI Studio.tag: Build multi-agent workflows with retrieval, tools and monitoring.
AgentForge: GenAI Studio.ask: Build an agent that answers HR policy questions from our handbook.
steps: Indexed the 84-page handbook into 412 searchable passages.
Created an answer agent and a checker agent that verifies every citation.
Ran 25 sample questions. 24 correct with page citations, 1 sent to HR.
Generated a deployment blueprint with logging and a monthly accuracy report.

OmniAgent Enterprise Platform.tag: Deploy secure AI agents with human oversight built in.
OmniAgent Enterprise Platform.ask: Let an agent draft supplier emails, but a person approves before sending.
steps: Connected the agent to your inbox and supplier list through MCP.
Agent can draft only. Sending needs a manager's approval.
Drafted 6 follow-ups for overdue purchase orders.
Manager approved 5, edited 1. Every action logged.

AI Business Operations Orchestrator.tag: A team of AI agents that runs the busywork of a small business.
AI Business Operations Orchestrator.ask: Get next week ready: posts, follow-ups, invoices and my calendar.
steps: Drafted 5 social posts and scheduled them for best times.
Wrote follow-ups to 8 leads who went quiet.
Found 3 unpaid invoices over 30 days and drafted reminders.
Blocked focus time and moved 2 meetings that clashed.

Nova Digitus Conversational AI.tag: Voice and chat assistant for customer conversations, with guardrails.
Nova Digitus Conversational AI.ask: Customer: 'My order hasn't arrived and I want a refund.'
steps: Detected: late delivery, refund request. Tone: frustrated.
Order #20417 is with the carrier, due tomorrow.
Refunds over $200 need a person. This one is $89, inside policy.
Apologized, shared tracking, and offered a refund or 15% off if it arrives.

Problem Crusher.tag: Turns a messy manual process into AI agents that run it.
Problem Crusher.ask: We copy web form leads into a spreadsheet and email each one by hand.
steps: Mapped the process: 6 manual steps, about 12 minutes per lead.
Capture agent files each lead. Qualify agent scores it. Reply agent drafts the email.
Ran 20 past leads through it. Matched your manual decisions 19 times.

AI CMO Platform.tag: A full AI marketing team for founders, in one dashboard.
AI CMO Platform.ask: Launch plan for our new $49 meal-prep subscription in Atlanta.
steps: Target: busy professionals 28 to 45 within 10 miles of Midtown.
Wrote 3 ad angles: time saved, eating healthy, no grocery runs.
Split budget: 50% Instagram, 30% Google, 20% local creators.
Set targets: $18 per sign-up, 400 sign-ups in 60 days.

AI SDR Agent Fleet.tag: AI sales team that prospects, writes outreach and qualifies leads.
AI SDR Agent Fleet.ask: Find 50 logistics companies in Texas that need route planning.
steps: Found 50 companies with 20 to 200 trucks and a recent hiring push.
Pulled one relevant fact per company for a personal opener.
Drafted a 3-email sequence for each, in your voice.
Ranked by fit. Top 12 marked call-first.

Sovereign Equity & Overage Recovery Engi.tag: Find and document unclaimed tax-sale and foreclosure surplus funds.
Sovereign Equity & Overage Recovery Engi.ask: Show surplus funds from tax sales in one sample county.
steps: Read 312 sample tax-sale results from the last 3 years.
38 sales left a surplus over $5,000 after the debt was paid.
Checked claim deadlines. 29 are still open.
Prepared a claim packet checklist for each open case.

Wealth Strategy Playbook.tag: Plan the buy, borrow, die strategy with holding-company structures.
Wealth Strategy Playbook.ask: Show how a $400k rental portfolio could fund living costs without selling.
steps: Sample portfolio: $400k value, $120k owed, rising 4% a year.
Line of credit at 55% loan-to-value releases about $100k over 5 years.
Checked a 20% price drop. Still under the lender's limit.
Showed how a holding company separates the properties from personal assets.

result.title: Illustration only
rows: Review with your CPA and attorney

Wealth in Health: Sound Healing.tag: Guided sound sessions with Solfeggio tones and cymatic visuals.
steps: You chose: wired and tired. Goal: fall asleep.
Built a session: 432 Hz base, slowing binaural beat from 10 Hz to 4 Hz.
Cymatic pattern slows with the sound, dimming over 10 minutes.
Session saved so you can see which ones help most.

Wealth in Health Index.tag: Links daily wellness habits to healthcare savings and investment growth.
Wealth in Health Index.ask: What is walking 30 minutes a day worth to me financially?
steps: Sample person: 42, walks 3 days a week now, wants 7.
Uses published research on activity and healthcare costs.
Estimated lower yearly healthcare spending, shown as a range.
Shows that saving invested at 6% for 20 years.

Monument: Archive of Black Innovation.tag: Interactive museum and patent archive of Black inventors.
Monument: Archive of Black Innovation.ask: Show inventors whose work shaped modern traffic and transport.
steps: Found inventors and patents connected to transport and road safety.
Opened a gallery on Garrett Morgan's traffic signal patent of 1923.
Placed related patents on a timeline from 1890 to today.
Built a 5-question classroom quiz from the gallery.

Tree of Life Interactive Map.tag: A seven-level 3D Tree of Life with an AI guide and audio.
Tree of Life Interactive Map.ask: Walk me through the first level and what it teaches.
steps: Opened level one in 3D and lit its path to level two.
Explained the level through Kemet, Kush and Kabbalah side by side.
Started the matching binaural track for reflection.
Suggested a 5-minute journaling prompt for the day.

AI Agentic Brain: Digital Illustration P.tag: Illustration studio with AI design agents and a color harmony engine.
AI Agentic Brain: Digital Illustration P.ask: Children's book cover: a fox reading under a tree at dusk.
steps: Drew 3 thumbnail layouts on the shared sketchpad.
Built a dusk palette: deep teal, amber, soft violet.
Refined layout 2 with clear space for the title.
Checked contrast so the title stays readable on shelves.

AuraDJ.tag: An AI DJ that reads your mood and builds sets that grow with you.
AuraDJ.ask: Focus music for a 90-minute work block.
steps: Learned you skip vocals during work and like lo-fi and soft house.
Built a 90-minute set that starts at 80 BPM and lifts to 110.
Skips and replays tune your next set.
